scope: Saved full-stack speech-input to translated-text quality. Gemini Transcribe is an ASR component, distinct from Gemini Live Translate. Latest pure-STT Soniox cascade replaces the older translation-enabled Soniox transcript cascade.
metric: Mean GEMBA-MQM penalty per cell; lower is better. Critical 25, major 5, minor 1. Failed/missing judgments excluded, never treated as zero penalty.

comparability.reasoning: Historical direct speech translation: explicit high. Historical Gemini/Qwen-ASR cascades: reasoning omitted/provider default. Latest Soniox pure-STT cascades: explicit medium. No new rejudging; descriptive historical comparison, not uniform-judge controlled experiment.
comparability.source: Recorded frozen synthesized speech of Korean canonical samples with context; targets en, ja, zh-Hans.
comparability.coverage: Common set contains only 618 source-language cells with successful judgments in all nine stacks; full successes and missing/failed counts retained separately.
comparability.latency: Quality includes ASR error propagation. This is not proof of integrated live end-to-end latency; cascades used separately collected ASR transcripts.
comparability.historicalGemmaSnapshot: Original partial-first-batch snapshot preserved with one unsuccessful judge; no retries or updates in this summary.

verification: Recomputed from saved normalized judgments. Exact cell-key uniqueness checked for every stack. Reproduced prior nine-model 618-cell means exactly before replacing the two Soniox cascades with final pure-STT results.
